FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Florida fishing licence

Visitors aged 16 or older need freshwater or saltwater coverage for the species they target. The free shoreline licence is only for Florida residents.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-12

Who needs one

  • Non-residents aged 16 or older, including anglers who release their catch.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16.
  • Saltwater anglers on properly licensed charter vessels or licensed piers.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Snook permit · $10 USD
    Required when taking or attempting to take snook unless a permit exemption applies. Check current FWC rules before targeting snook.
  • Spiny lobster permit · $5 USD
    Required for lobster take or attempted take unless exempt.
  • State Reef Fish Angler designation · $0 USD
    Required from age 16 for specified reef fish from a private vessel, including many licence-exempt anglers.
  • Shore-based Shark Fishing permit · $0 USD
    Required from age 16 for shore-based shark fishing; complete the course and renew annually.

Saltwater

Separate freshwater and saltwater licences follow the target species, including in mixed waters.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Confirm the vessel’s current saltwater charter license with the operator. The exemption does not extend to separate shore outings or freshwater guide trips.

Rules visitors should know

  • An out-of-state licence is not valid in Florida.
  • Saltwater landings in Florida require coverage even when the fish came from federal waters.

How to buy

Use FWC’s official purchase channels. If the short-term visitor option is absent online, contact a listed license agent or tax collector before travel.

License-free days

Freshwater: first consecutive Saturday and Sunday in April, and second consecutive Saturday and Sunday in June. Saltwater: first consecutive Saturday and Sunday in June, first Saturday in September, and Saturday after Thanksgiving. Other fishing rules still apply.

Check a visitor outing with the Florida license planner.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Florida?

Visitors aged 16 or older need freshwater or saltwater coverage for the species they target. The free shoreline licence is only for Florida residents.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Florida?

Non-resident freshwater 3-day: $17 USD; Non-resident freshwater 7-day: $30 USD; Non-resident freshwater annual: $47 USD; Non-resident saltwater 3-day: $17 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Florida?

Use FWC’s official purchase channels. If the short-term visitor option is absent online, contact a listed license agent or tax collector before travel.
